correctness.rationale: Two exhaustive perfect-matching enumerations agree on exactly eight facets; all nerve faces agree by intersection and edge-membership definitions. The 26 hard-coded free-face pairs are checked against every surviving coface, reducing the nerve to a connected graph with five vertices and six edges. The nerve lemma therefore proves the full integral homotopy result, including nonabelian fundamental group.

value.rationale: The Frucht graph is a canonical twelve-vertex cubic asymmetric graph. Its pure dimension-five perfect-matching complex surprisingly retains a free nonabelian rank-two fundamental group and fails shellability, while its distinct ordinary matching complex is a wedge of twenty 3-spheres. A complete rigorous classification of this natural graph/complex pair plus the 29 nonextendible pairs is meaningful beyond a routine tabulation.
